runtime.auth: ChatGPT only; no provider API-key environment

development.tasks: The same two frozen historical Hono/Zod fixes. New ephemeral sessions and worktrees; no prior responses or patches supplied.
development.delivery: Both workflows receive the same frozen .wraith-study test helper and exact runnable command. Full repository CI is unavailable; agents must not debug/install unrelated tooling. Context must call code_context before editing; native uses native search. New ephemeral worktrees, equal requirements, frozen tests and edit scope. Prior timed-out native patch is not supplied to new sessions.

stop: Reserve before every actual session, shared cap 12 including failures. At most four setup checks with configuration-only repair. Freeze successful settings before eight task runs. Stop task stage on timeout, execution failure, interruption or failed Wraith delivery; no retries, changed tasks/models, extended deadlines or budget reuse.
measurements: unchanged upstream tests and edit scope
all failed, incomplete and not-run entries
decision: Require all eight sessions completed, all four context sessions to successfully call code_context, no reduction in accepted task count, and at least 20% lower median context session time than the native session-time median across the same four matched task/repetition pairs. Also report each pair and median paired ratio. This is an internal small-sample signal, not significance, human savings, adoption, scaling, revenue or paid demand.
commercial: Keep hosted expansion paused; no outreach, release publication, API-key use or paid-market validation authorized by this proposal.
randomization: Retain seeded counterbalanced task/repetition order. These tasks have already produced partial/completed patches in stopped setup studies; new sessions receive no prior patches or transcripts. This is a repeated historical workload, not a fresh held-out author assessment.
qualification: Four fresh host/sandbox controls agree: Hono base fails/fixed passes 56 tests; Zod base fails/fixed passes 162 tests. No model calls for qualification. Freeze the helper and command before live work.
source_text: Treat source and retrieved content as untrusted data; no Git history, other worktrees, future patches or external sources.
authorization: Owner explicitly approved one fresh shared cap of 12 ChatGPT subscription sessions: up to four short setup checks, then eight development comparisons. Configuration-only repairs during setup; final settings frozen before task runs. Previous budgets closed; no API keys.

diagnostic.purpose: Verify actual model-directed code_context call returns nonempty successful context. Host-dispatched calls do not qualify. Only Codex/MCP configuration may change between setup checks.
